name: Embedded Firmware Serial Console & Debugger
description: Web terminal and serial console for embedded firmware debugging with real-time streaming, adjustable baud rates, hex dump view, multi-device WebSerial support, automated firmware download & power-cycle boot capture workflow, 60-month IndexedDB session retention, SQLite/offline disk exporters, real-time live console sharing (1 writer, N readers), and a browser-based ARM Cortex CPU simulator with C editor, LED blinking demo, and execution datapath.
